module.name: legend
module.description: A colour legend / key — swatches with labels, laid out in a row or column. Swatches can mimic real plot handles (circle, square, triangle, star, diamond, and solid/dashed/dotted/dash-dot lines), so the key matches the chart beside it.
module.aiSpec:
A colour LEGEND / key — plot-style handles next to labels. Block module: split the body with `<!-- @ -->`, one entry per section written `#color: Label` (or `colorname | Label`), e.g. `#ef4444: Errors`. Use it to explain the colours in a chart, diagram or map on the same slide (it does not draw the chart itself).
PER-ENTRY HANDLES — put shape/line tokens after the colour, before the `:`:
#1f77b4 o-: Deep unfolding circle marker on a solid line #595959 s--: Best parameters square marker on a dashed line #d62728 -: MLEM (baseline) solid line, no marker #22c55e ^: Passing triangle marker, no line
markers: `o` circle, `s` square, `^` triangle, `v` triangle-down, `d` diamond, `*` star (or the words circle/square/triangle/ triangle-down/diamond/star/none) lines: `-` solid, `--` dashed, `..` dotted, `-.` dash-dot (or the words solid/dashed/dotted/dashdot; `..` not `:`, because `:` separates the label)
Labels are rendered as Markdown + KaTeX (like the graph module's labels), so math (`$..$` or backslash-paren delimiters) and inline emphasis both work.
Tokens may be glued (`o--`) or spaced (`o --`). An entry that carries tokens describes its WHOLE handle, so `-` is a bare line (no marker), `o` a bare marker (no line) and `o-` both — as in matplotlib's format strings. An entry with no token at all falls back to the module's `shape` / `line` parameters.
Match the handles to the real plot: if two series differ only by colour, give them the SAME handle.
Parameters (defaults for entries that carry no tokens): - `direction` (row|column, default row): row wraps horizontally; column stacks. - `shape` (square|circle|triangle|triangle-down|diamond|star|line|none, default square): marker shape. `line` = a plain solid line. - `line` (none|solid|dashed|dotted|dashdot, default none): line through the marker. - `size` (small|medium|large, default medium): swatch size. - `gap`: CSS gap between entries (default 8px 18px). - `bold` (true|false, default false): bold the labels.
Example: <!-- @legend direction: column, size: large --> #22c55e o-: Passing <!-- @ --> #f59e0b s--: Flaky <!-- @ --> #ef4444 ^..: Failing <!-- @end -->

param.name: direction
param.label: Direction
param.desc: Lay entries in a wrapping row or a vertical column.

param.name: shape
param.label: Marker shape
param.desc: Default marker for entries that carry no token of their own.

param.name: line
param.label: Line style
param.desc: Default line drawn through the marker, as in a plot legend.
